fields.label: Department
fields.note: Hierarchical facets from the site bundle: parent_department_<Name>:=true / child_department_<Name>:=true (e.g. parent_department_Engineering:=true). A plain department:=Engineering filter also returned hits.

fields.label: Region
fields.note: region_EMEA:=true / location_EMEA:=true (same for APAC/Americas); city-level location_string is a document field, not a facet.

fields.label: Remote
fields.note: remote:=true refinement in the site's search state.

fields.label: Date posted
fields.note: time_type refinement is part of the UI search state; its accepted values were not extracted, so none are listed.

notes: The careers frontend reads TYPESENSE_HOST/TYPESENSE_COLLECTION/TYPESENSE_PUBLIC_KEY from /assets/scripts/main-*.js and queries https://<host>.a1.typesense.net/collections/careers_alias/documents/search with q, preset=careers_list_view, per_page, page and filter_by. Confirmed live: q=*&preset=careers_list_view returns found=401, while filter_by=department:=Engineering returns found=55, so native keyword and facet filtering work. The UI's refinement list also exposes parent/child_department_*, region_*/location_*, remote and time_type.
